title: Derived pullback cohomology where a connective object is locally free in one degree
statement: Let g:T'→T be a morphism of schemes, E∈D(O_T) as in [def-pc-derived-category], and i a natural number. Suppose H^n(E)=0 for every integer n<0. Suppose every point t in the image of g has an open neighbourhood U and a natural r (allowed to depend on t) such that H^q(E)|U is zero for natural q≠i and H^i(E)|U is finite locally free of rank r, in the sense of [def-pc-invertible-in-degree-zero]. Then H^i(Lg^*E) is isomorphic to g^*H^i(E), for the ordinary pullback of [def-pc-module-pullback] and derived pullback of [def-pc-derived-pullback]. This is a statement about arbitrary connective derived objects and does not assume a proper morphism, a sheaf F, or a perfect-locus condition.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-derived-single-open-locus] to S=range(g), obtaining an open W containing the image, a flat sheaf M=H^i(E)|W, and an isomorphism L(W.ι)^*E≅M placed in degree i. The universal property of an open immersion provides f:T′→W with f≫W.ι=g.

Use the single complex on M in degree i. It is bounded above by i; its degree-i term is flat, and all other terms are zero and flat. The additive monoidal structure from [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed] and ObjectProperty.flat_of_isZero prove the zero-term flatness; exactFunctor is invariant under the single-term isomorphism. Apply [lem-pc-flat-complex-derived-pullback]. Transport its Qh comparison through quotientCompQhIso, mapHomotopyCategoryFactors and singleMapHomologicalComplex. Tensor pullback and ordinary pullback are left adjoints to the same pushforward [def-pc-module-pullback], so left-adjoint uniqueness identifies them. This proves the private helper nonempty_derivedPullback_flat_single_iso, with no new hole.

The comparison of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] identifies Lg^*E with Lf^*L(W.ι)^*E. Map the open-locus isomorphism by Lf^*, then compose with the flat-single helper from the second step. Map this isomorphism by H^i and compose with singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso. Finally use restrictFunctorIsoPullback and pullbackComp from [def-pc-module-pullback], and transport along f≫W.ι=g. The resulting composite has exactly the original source and target.

lean.statement: theorem nonempty_homology_derivedPullback_iso_of_locally_single [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ T) (E : schemeDerivedCategory T) (i : ℕ) (hneg : ∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) n).obj E)) (hloc : ∀ t ∈ Set.range g.base, ∃ U : T.Opens, t ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ, IsFiniteLocallyFreeInDegree (fun q : ℕ ↦ (Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) q).obj E)) i r) : Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) i).obj ((derivedPullback g).obj E) ≅ (Modules.pullback g).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
